notes: Every task (and every repair) ends with the same completion sound. Before, each played a different one at the end, on top of the right one.

notes_by_language.pt_BR: Toda tarefa (e todo reparo) termina com o mesmo som de concluído. Antes cada uma tocava um som diferente no fim, por cima do certo.
notes_by_language.en_US: Every task (and every repair) ends with the same completion sound. Before, each played a different one at the end, on top of the right one.
